prior.author: C4 researcher draft with AI assistance; not elicited expert responses

sources.title: Principles for Managing Essential Processing in Multimedia Learning, Cambridge Handbook of Multimedia Learning
sources.scope: Publisher summary supports learner-paced segmentation in multimedia learning. Transfer to this text-based guidance interface and numeric coefficients are unvalidated researcher hypotheses.

sources.title: Kalyuga, Ayres, Chandler and Sweller (2003), The Expertise Reversal Effect
sources.scope: Publisher abstract describes instructional effectiveness depending on learner experience. Self-reported familiarity is an imperfect proxy; no five-point thresholds or coefficients are established by this source.

sources.title: Jakob Nielsen (2006), Progressive Disclosure, Nielsen Norman Group
sources.scope: Author guidance on deferring secondary options, distinct from staged disclosure. C4 may collapse only separately reviewed supplementary content; source requirements remain visible. This is design guidance, not C4 empirical evidence.

sources.title: Richard E. Mayer, Multimedia Learning (3rd edition), Signaling Principle
sources.scope: Signaling motivates testing organizational cues. Specific branch/dependency/parallel diagrams and their weights are researcher extrapolations, not conclusions established for this system.

judgments.rationale: Tentatively favor paced guidance for the least familiar self-report category. Test assumption; not an expert response.
Tentatively favor pacing for lower familiarity. Category cutoff is provisional.
Tentatively reduce extra pacing for higher familiarity; does not force Overview.
Tentatively reduce pacing for the most familiar self-report category. Familiarity is not measured expertise.
More supplied steps tentatively increase value of pacing. Interdependent steps may instead benefit from an overview; weak hypothesis only.
Tentatively defer reviewed supplementary explanations when original information volume grows. Hard feasibility still prevents hiding required information.
Tentatively favor explicit prerequisite reminders when supplied dependencies grow; no completion inferred.
Tentatively favor inspecting supplied alternatives with a map. Exact diagram suitability requires validation.
Tentatively favor an explicit dependency map as supplied depth grows. This does not add AND/OR semantics.
Tentatively favor visualization of explicitly supplied parallel groups. No independence beyond source assertions inferred.
Exploratory assumption that pacing may help low reported navigation capability; extra navigation could also burden users. Validate directly.
Exploratory low-weight pacing hypothesis for navigation category 2, pending direct user and expert evidence.

decision.selection_reason: Maximum sampled linear score among hard-feasible candidates, using one shared parameter draw.
